g.text: Weekly ARE consultation incidence, one row per ISO year (top = earliest), one cell per ISO week
Acute respiratory illness in Germany: does every year follow the same cycle?
Main pattern: every year repeats a winter-high / summer-low cycle (the peak of 13 of 13 complete ISO years falls in weeks 40–12), but timing and strength vary: the early-year wave is
missing in 2021, and the highest value (3,215) is in week 50 of 2022.
Data: Robert Koch-Institut, ARE-Praxis-Sentinel, ARE-Konsultationsinzidenz (CC BY 4.0); Germany (Bundesweit), all ages (00+). Empty cells: weeks not covered by the data.
